rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with OWASP ZAP security testing tool through a .NET implementation. Provides Docker Compose management for zero-config setup with automatic API key generation and 14 MCP tools covering scanning operations, spider crawling, active vulnerability detection, and alert management. Built as a .NET global tool with support for both managed ZAP containers and existing instances.
